entries.title: ServiceLink Auction collector workflow
entries.summary: # ServiceLink Auction collector workflow The ServiceLink collector reads only the public listing route observed in the reference audit: ```text GET https://www.servicelinkauction.com/api/listingsvc/v1/Listings?limit=<1..100> ``` It sends only `Accept: application/json`.
